notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA105: W8-SA105B 750 x 500 illustrated (A 600 x 400, C 900 x 600; PNG W8-SA105A.png), yellow, R50, 10 / 30. Distance numerals 125 E ('varies', dashed box; the line is centred as a whole, '=' margins on the sheet), 53 gap, m 105 E lower case (105 wide), baseline 220; AHEAD 125 D baseline 405 (185 pitch, 95 below), 538 (106/538/106). The sheet gives no example: generated at 100 to 500 m in hundreds — not confirmed against SA practice.
